columns.name: "name" varchar(80) NOT NULL
columns.role: "role" text DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL CHECK ("role" IN ('member', 'admin'))

indexes.users_email_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "users_email_key" ON "users" ("email")

columns.user_id: "user_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.label: "label" varchar(80) DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL

indexes.api_keys_user_id_idx: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "api_keys_user_id_idx" ON "api_keys" ("user_id")
indexes.api_keys_hash_key: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "api_keys_hash_key" ON "api_keys" ("hash")

columns.title: "title" varchar(200) NOT NULL
columns.owner_id: "owner_id" uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES "users"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE

indexes.notes_color_idx: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "notes_color_idx" ON "notes" ("color")
indexes.notes_owner_id_idx: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "notes_owner_id_idx" ON "notes" ("owner_id")
